name: Varsha Tyagi
title: Senior Software Engineer @ Ciena
bio: Senior Software Engineer and Networking Automation Specialist with extensive experience in Python development, L2 networking protocols (Switching, VLANs, STP, Ethernet), and Passive Optical Network (PON) architecture and performance monitoring.

experience.description: Leading network automation initiatives, architecting test automation frameworks using Python and Ixia, and managing L2 networking validation across optical and Ethernet infrastructure.
Engineered automated testing suites for L2 protocols (VLANs, STP) and passive optical network (PON) systems, optimizing network performance monitoring and hardware validation.
Developed firmware and automation scripts in C and Python for telecommunications equipment and embedded network protocol stacks.

projects.title: Automated L2/PON Network Testing Framework
projects.description: Designed and deployed Python-based network automation suites using Ixia hardware to simulate, stress-test, and monitor L2 switching protocols and PON architectures.
